[[File:Joe Olson 2020 Player of the Year.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Joe Olson with his trophy, 2020 Player of the Year awards.]]
'''Joe Olson''' (GEMP handle '''arebelspy''') is a member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> and a three-time World Champion (2020, 2021, 2024). He won the [[2022 U.S. National Championship]],<ref name="pc-2022USNationalChampionship" /> the [[2019 North American Continental Championship]], the [[2015 Match Play Championship]], the [[2015 San Diego Grand Prix]], and the [[2000 Portland Grand Slam]].<ref name="gs00" /> Olson also won the [[2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix]]<ref name="pc-2025LasVegasGrandPrix" /> and Day 2 of the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]].
